title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: custom engine agents for DoD users
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing statements and documented controls are supported. It correctly distinguishes general agent documentation from confirmed DoD availability, including the block API's exclusion of DoD and the limits on SDK-built agents.

claims.claim: The roadmap item announces that DoD users will be able to use custom engine agents.
claims.quote: Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents.
